release: Event-driven game-day data (calendar, watcher, verified publication)
purpose: Narrow, additions-only exception to the V6 protected-path guard for the reviewed event-driven refresh modules. Applies only to pull requests from v7-development in this repository; every other branch keeps the strict byte-identical guard. No existing protected file may change. Remove after this release is merged.

added_files.src/cfb_analytics/event_calendar.py: Pure calendar of game completion, poll and CFP release windows (no I/O, no model changes)
added_files.src/cfb_analytics/event_watcher.py: Watcher that detects finals, corrections and poll releases, dispatches the existing refresh workflows and verifies the live site
added_files.src/cfb_analytics/cfp_publish.py: Publishes official CFP rankings only when the dated official release parses completely and CFBD confirms it (evidence file per release)
added_files.src/cfb_analytics/postseason.py: Postseason games and predictions from the existing official formula and published ratings (ratings unchanged)
